text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a sharp four-day recovery from a two-week low set on November 9th. The stock has climbed nearly $8 in that stretch as oil prices stabilized—US crude is trading around $89.62 a barrel—and heating oil prices surging 59% year-over-year signal sustained demand for refined petroleum products heading into winter, which supports refiner and integrated energy producer margins.

The broader tailwind here is that global oil markets are tightening despite Russia's crude output rebounding after recent sanctions relief. Strong heating oil demand against a backdrop of persistent supply concerns has oil-linked equities recovering after earlier weakness, though crude remains below summer peaks, leaving the stock down 7.6% over the full two weeks.
